record.field: LAB (staging only). Prepare a DRAFT email campaign for the companies that are cooling down for some salespeople, the same ones pms_salesperson_cooling_customers lists for date_to (use the date the data reaches). The body is simple HTML written by you (paragraphs, bold, lists, https links; no images, scripts or {{ }}), wrapped in the basic mailing theme with an unsubscribe link. Leaves out, with the reason, companies without a valid email, blacklisted or opted out, agencies, archived and repeated emails. Two steps: confirm=false previews the recipients, the left out and the text; show it and, only after the user's approval, call again with confirm=true, the token and exactly the same arguments, body included. It never sends: a person reviews and sends the draft from Email Marketing.
